prompt: Implement Ledger.transfer(key, src, dst, amount) in ledger.py. Amount is a positive integer (bool is invalid); src and dst must differ and both accounts must exist. Reject insufficient funds with ValueError. A successful transfer and its idempotency record must commit atomically. Reusing a key with exactly the same src,dst,amount returns False without another transfer; reusing it with any different payload raises ValueError. A fresh success returns True. Validation failures leave both balances and operation records unchanged. The public db attribute is used by tests and callers. Connections are single-threaded and not already in a transaction when transfer is called. Persistence must work across Ledger instances on the same file.
